name: clip-possible
description: Impossible poses, found and bent back. (1) The rest pose, no keys: every joint inside the clinical limits, level typical. (2) The left foot turned 110 deg outward about the ankle's own toe-out axis. The ankle's zero direction u = unit(toe3-1.L - foot.L rest heads) = (0.0946714, -0.9406275, -0.3259711); the toe-out axis is unit(u x (X - u (u.X))) = (0, -0.3274418, 0.9448713), so the quaternion is (axis sin 55, cos 55) = (0, -0.2682246, 0.7739933, 0.5735764). The swing reads 110 along that axis (abduction 110) and 110 x 0.0327904 = 3.6069 along the flexion axis (-0.9949732, -0.1001412, 0), which is not quite square to it. The possible limit for ankle toe-out is -80..80 (assets/rig/ranges.json), so the foot is 30 deg past: level impossible, one breach. (3) Keyed, then clip.fix_impossible bends the toe-out back to 80 - 0.5 = 79.5 and leaves the flexion at 3.6069: one key fixed, nothing added or left. (4) Measured again: typical (ankle toe-out is in no clinical pair).

notes: the animation has no keys: measuring the pose shown alone
